cards.name: what-this-facebook-name
cards.title: What This Facebook Name Checker Does

groups.label: It opens the facebook.com URL
groups.text: When a name passes, the checker shows an Open facebook.com/… button.

groups.label: It can't promise a name is free
groups.text: Facebook doesn't offer a public availability check.

cards.name: how-to
cards.title: How to Check if a Facebook Username Is Available

cards.name: best-practices
cards.title: Best Practices for Picking a Facebook Username

good.label: Do
items: Match the name people already know
Use periods only where they help
Think about the Page name too

cards.name: key-point
cards.kicker: Facebook Username Rules at a Glance
cards.quote: A Facebook username has to be 5 to 50 characters long and can only use letters, numbers and periods.
